changes.summary: Added unlocked-area-only selection semantics and responsive area selector controls; web-lite camera remains anchored to the existing single-scene presentation.
Staging now copies the complete dist asset set with relative asset URLs; all three staged entrypoints passed Chromium startup smoke with canvas mounted and no console/page errors.
Employee findTask now always advances through selectTarget and moveToTarget before work, even on large simulation ticks; the documented task-selection chain is covered by a regression test.
All six area layouts now expose a contiguous camera origin; world objects share a translated root and a fresh Chromium run switched from unlocked area 1 to area 2 with canvas visible and no errors.

Courier orders now persist through queued → inTransit → completed phases; pickup consumes shelf stock, completion credits the configured product reward, in-transit progress survives normalizeSave, and the delivery_instant rewarded branch completes the next pickup immediately.
Gull employees now run observable flying → exploring → returning phases, credit a level-based reward on return, and accept the rewarded-ad multiplier through the shared state bridge.

The offline_double rewarded branch now persists an offline multiplier window and applies it during refresh recovery to automated gull/delivery income; the window is consumed by recovered elapsed time.

Customer presentation now holds at the entry door, follows obstacle-aware side corridors around solid 3D fixtures, hides route overlays by default, slows to a 1500ms walk, preserves the shelf stop for saved checkout customers, and keeps checkout motion ticking after state-signature stabilization.

remainingBlockers.reason: Official WeChat/Douyin/TapTap SDK, policy, and native-device QA evidence are unavailable; staged packages remain publishable=false.
Rewarded-ad bridge is safe and tested, but all adapters intentionally return sdk-unavailable until official SDK integration and reward receipt evidence exist.
Area camera origins and web-lite slot switching now work, but area-specific production chains and native-platform camera/layout remain absent.
Historical run state remains ABANDONED because EXPERIENCE_CONTRACT, FEEL_PROTOTYPE, and PERCEPTUAL_QA stages were never emitted; this continuation does not rewrite that state.
